summary: Momentus Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) under Rule 424(b)(5) for an at-the-market offering of up to $75 million of its Class A common stock. The company entered into a sales agreement with A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners as sales agent on a commercially reasonable efforts basis, receiving a 3% commission. As of June 17, 2026, the last reported sale price was $10.06 per share. This shelf takedown is an ordinary equity financing and does not constitute a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign.
